correctness.rationale: For a finite Hermitian open diamond chain N≥2 with four nonzero hub-arm edges per link and no bypass edges, vanishing all off-diagonal hub amplitudes of exp(-itH) at all real times forces the adjacent-hub second moment (H²)_{j+1,j}=w_j* v_j to vanish. Its third moment then reduces to (u_j-l_j)conj(w_{j,U})v_{j,U}; nonzero edges force equal arm energies. Conversely w_j*v_j=0 and D_j=epsilon_j I make the normalized link vectors V_j,W_j orthogonal, define disjoint H-invariant hub-centered cages of sizes 2,3,...,3,2, and yield an exact direct sum. Taylor expansion gives first nonzero leakage amplitude order t² under nonzero inner product and t³ under pure unequal arm energies; probabilities begin at t⁴/t⁶. Independent exact 7-site matrix/basis calculation confirmed second/third moments and the 2+3+2 decomposition.
